limitations: The 1988 USAF field study itself cites Maurer lineage histories, so matching both publications is NOT independent evidence.
A group may have arrived before the field was declared operational; initial operational date is not identical to arrival date.
An airfield transfer from USAAF control is not proof that all aircraft/units had left the physical runway.
1988 listing includes postwar stationing months despite the D-Day to VE-Day title; 1945-05 month is not guaranteed pre-9-May.
Corrected candidates are not definitive historical geolocations or precise unit arrival and departure dates.
The source PDF web text was inspected. Visual screenshot could not be retrieved in this environment; unconfirmed originals remain research-only.
The base OCR transcription and its first-pass 75 flags are kept immutable. This review is a derivative overlay; downstream readers must apply it rather than treating first-pass flags as current.
